Chhattisgarh Teacher Recruitment Begins Amidst Rule Dispute

Chhattisgarh has initiated the recruitment process for 2,292 assistant teacher positions. The process is underway despite controversy surrounding new eligibility rules. Separately, teachers in the state have been issued an ultimatum: attendance must be logged via an app, or their July salaries will be withheld, sparking anger among teacher organizations.
